verdict.rationale: Docs claim 'pre-mapped controls' and managing SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS 'in one place,' implying some shared-control mapping, but there is no explicit description of how evidence/controls map across frameworks or how overlap is visualized to a security engineer. Missing for 10: explicit cross-framework control-mapping mechanics, UI/dashboard showing overlap percentages, and independent/hands-on confirmation that SOC 2 evidence auto-satisfies ISO 27001/HIPAA requirements.
